newsitem.title: UK: Britain and Russia sign civil nuclear energy pact.
newsitem.headline: Britain and Russia sign civil nuclear energy pact.

text.p: Britain said on Tuesday it had signed an agreement with Russia to promote cooperation in civilian nuclear power.

The pact, signed by Energy Minister Lord Fraser of Carmyllie and visiting Russian Minister for Atomic Energy Viktor Mikhailov, will promote cooperation in design, construction and safety of nuclear power stations, decommissioning and waste management and conversion of weapons grade materials.
Cooperation will be implemented through arrangements to be negotiated separately between commercial or other organisations directly involved, the Department of Trade Industry said.

Lord Fraser said the agreement "will encourage our industries to strengthen cooperation. They have had useful contacts for many years, and will continue to exchange expertise and develop commercial business together."
The pact will also cover collaboration in the control and protection of nuclear materials.
